paper_title: Deep learning of left atrial structure and function provides link to atrial fibrillation risk

concerns_full.concern_text: Is it necessary to adjust cox models for height AND weight when adjusting for BMI? Should use BSA-indexed LA measurements for clinical relevance.
More details needed on training/test set for abnormal contraction pattern model. Performance metrics (sensitivity/specificity) not provided.

paper_title: Cell-free DNA testing for detection and prognosis prediction of pancreatic cancer

concerns_full.concern_text: External validation cohort characteristics and size should be clearly reported. Performance in early-stage pancreatic cancer is critical but may be limited.

paper_title: AI-enhanced integration of genetic and medical imaging data for risk assessment of Type 2 diabetes

concerns_full.concern_text: T2D case/control definition problematic: someone self-reported no T2D + GLU-AC<100 but HbA1c>6.5% would be classified as control. T2D definition differs between line 211 and Figure 2.

Genetic-centric and genetic-imaging analyses used different statistical approaches. Is AUC comparison fair with different model types? Over 100 imaging variables makes clinical applicability questionable.
Early detection analysis only selects women and age threshold of 59 — these selections come from nowhere. No reasoning provided. Comment on generalizability to males.

paper_title: Integration of clinical, pathological, radiological, and transcriptomic data improves prediction for first-line immunotherapy outcome in metastatic NSCLC

concerns_full.concern_text: Figure 3: multimodal predictions not statistically significantly better than unimodal RNA data alone. Must show the multimodal approach surpasses previously established transcriptomic-only models.

Framework for multimodal survival/prognosis prediction is not novel — many prior studies (Rami 2022, Lipkova 2022, Wang 2023). Authors only applied existing algorithms, raising concerns about novelty.
Results are nothing more than a case study. Urgent need to show how multimodal data can be used as a predictive biomarker. Feature importance analysis in Results is not comprehensive enough.
